iphone_use.description: Phone Use for a USB iPhone (pua_* tools): setup, readiness, taps, typing, and preview pause. The live screen is the Phone Use Mini App, not these tools.

android_use.description: Phone Use for an Android phone or emulator over adb with the Mobilerun Portal (android_* tools): setup, readiness, accessibility nodes, taps, Unicode typing, apps, and preview pause. No analytics. The live screen is the Phone Use Mini App.
